title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: OKX exchange raises fresh capital at $25B valuation
summary: OKX raised an undisclosed amount at a $25 billion valuation as an extension to March’s investment round led by the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange.

summary: A London quantitative hedge fund joins the round too, seven months after the NYSE's owner bought in at exactly the same price.

title: Ondo opens private markets with tokenized pre-IPO AI exposure
summary: Ondo’s tokenized notes will give eligible investors exposure to private companies, with the first tied to an unnamed pre-IPO AI company.

title: 中美AI軍事化背景下 BBC獲悉五角大樓正式停用 Anthropic 工具

title: DeFi Development Corp Adds $3 Million in Solana as SOL Buys Slow
summary: Nasdaq-listed DeFi Development Corp's latest SEC filing shows its Solana stash grew 1%, to about 2.56 million SOL and SOL equivalents—roughly half the prior week's gain and well below mid-September's pace.

title: A Florida Woman Used Claude as a Diary. An Anthropic Employee Read It and Reported It to Police
summary: Investigators say a Bonita Springs woman's Claude "diary" tripped Anthropic's safety filters. A human review team sent it to police, and Anthropic's own terms allow exactly that.
